context.body: Jesus quotes Psalm 110:1, not its Melchizedek line. His reading keeps the identity of the psalm’s addressed Lord open for later writers to explore.
context.label: The psalm before the priestly verse

observations.body: The Pharisees identify the Christ as David’s son; Jesus quotes the right-hand saying and asks how David can also call him Lord.
observations.label: Jesus turns an accepted title into a question

observations.body: A quick answer about descent is followed by a psalm quotation and a second question that no one answers.
observations.label: Answer, quotation, silence

payload.posture: Inspect Matthew 22:41–46 as a bounded source before following its claims into another passage.
payload.tension: The scene exposes a difficulty in the son-of-David answer but does not provide a full explanation of how sonship and lordship fit together.
payload.title: Jesus asks whose son the Christ is
